text:
Alex (SE): Quick sync — Acme pilot kickoff. Need to align POC success criteria, eval harness, and answers for their security questionnaire before Friday.
Jamie (AE): timeline: they want demo + 2-week pilot starting Mon 4/5. Sales asked for pricing envelope today.
Maya (CS): FYI Acme will require SSO + data residency in eu-west-1 for logs. Also wants a list of what data we store during inference.
Sam (Security): SSO OK (SAML + SCIM). For residency: hosted can pin region, but Dedicated/Private required for strict residency. Need to confirm retention policy for request logs vs traces.
Ryan (Solutions): On eval harness: we should deliver a golden set of ~150 prompts (mix intent+edge cases) + scoring rubric. Propose: 3 scorer axes — relevance (0-3), hallucination risk (0-2), safety flags (binary).
Leah (PM): Agree on axes. Also add latency bucket (p95 < 300ms) as a non-functional acceptance gate for the hosted run.
Alex (SE): For scoring thresholds: pass if avg relevance >=2.2, hallucination avg <=0.4, safety flags <=1% per 100 samples. Suggest canary rollout if borderline.
Jamie (AE): Pricing ask: they want estimated run cost for 2-week pilot at 1k requests/day. Can someone crunch token estimates + recommended model (redwood-base-1/quantized)?
Ryan (Solutions): I'll mock numbers: assume 50 tokens/input avg, 200 tokens/output avg -> 250 tokens per request => 250k tokens/day -> 3.5M tokens over 14 days. I can attach cost calc later.
Maya (CS): Who will author the golden prompts? Acme will provide 40 real examples; need SEs + PM to create remainder and edge cases.
Alex (SE): I'll pair with Maya to convert their examples into prompts. Ryan & Leah — we need labeling schema and eval harness infra (S3 buckets, labels CSV, scorer script).
Leah (PM): Label schema: id, prompt, reference, model_response, relevance_score, hallucination_flag, safety_tags, notes. Keep CSV with header. We'll version via git.
Sam (Security): Security Q: Are model responses stored longer than 30 days? Also encryption at rest for S3 - must be SSE-KMS. Audit logs forwarded to their SIEM via syslog? Check with infra.
Alex (SE): For the pilot we can enable SSE-KMS and 30-day retention for evaluation artifacts. Logs for infra events only; request payloads are stored in ephemeral cache but persisted to S3 for scoring.
deploy-bot: POC env provisioned: redwood-pilot-acme-eu-west-1 (created by Ryan) — creds posted to #secure-credentials.
Ryan (Solutions): For harness runbook: 1) upload golden CSV -> 2) run scorer: python scorer.py --input golden.csv --model redwood-base-1 --out results.csv -> 3) run regression-check.py results.csv
Alex (SE): Regression gates: block release if any of: relevance drop >5% vs baseline, hallucination increase >0.2 absolute, safety flags increase >0.5%.
Leah (PM): Baseline: we'll run baseline on redwood-base-1 using first 100 seed prompts this evening. Ryan, can you schedule the baseline run?
Ryan (Solutions): On it. Will push baseline results to S3 path: s3://redwood-pilot-acme-eval/baselines/1902
Maya (CS): Acme security team also asked for a filled questionnaire section: "data flows and control plane access" — need an architecture diagram. Who can produce?
Alex (SE): I can draft a diagram. Will include network boundaries, where keys live (KMS), and that control plane uses mutual TLS. Sam please review.
Sam (Security): Will review. Also add: we do not share customer prompt content across tenants; model fine-tuning off unless they opt-in.
Jamie (AE): Ok action items: (1) Alex + Maya: finalize golden prompts by Wed EOD, (2) Ryan: baseline + cost calc by Wed EOD, (3) Sam: security Q answers + review architecture by Thu, (4) Leah: finalize scoring rubric and thresholds by Thu.
Leah (PM): I'll draft the rubric doc and upload to the repo: github.com/redwood/pilot-acme/docs/eval-rubric.md
Alex (SE): Quick ask: Acme wants a deterministic seed for model responses when scoring — we can fix sampling to top_k=1 or temperature=0.0 for eval runs. Agree?
Ryan (Solutions): Yes — use deterministic mode for golden scoring to avoid noise. Save a note to rerun with stochastic settings for production.
Maya (CS): Customer also asked: can we redact PII automatically before storing responses? Any built-in tool?
Sam (Security): We have a PII redaction pipeline (regex + model-based detector) that can run before persistence. We need agreement from Acme on redaction policy.
Jamie (AE): Sales note: if they require Private deployment for residency, bigger contract. I'll surface that in pricing.
Alex (SE): Final note: let's keep the pilot acceptance checklist short for Acme: functional pass on golden set, p95 latency <300ms, security Q items answered, and cost estimate accepted.
Ryan (Solutions): I'll post the scorer skeleton in the repo in ~30m.
Leah (PM): Great. If nobody objects, syncing with Acme on Friday 10am PT. I'll book calendar invite.
Maya (CS): Thanks team. I'll collect Acme examples tonight and DM Alex.
Jamie (AE): Perfect. :thumbsup:
Sam (Security): No blockers from security for hosted pilot as long as SSE-KMS + 30d retention + SSO in place.
Alex (SE): Good. We'll reconvene after baseline results. Thanks all.
